title: Backup
description: POST /api/backup (src/WebServerBackup.cpp, lib/ConfigBackup): the settings backup file, format 1 (specs/033-config-backup/contracts/backup-file.md). Hand-written, not generated.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC; left out when the device clock wasn't set.

settings.description: Every setting as GET /api/config shows it: a set secret is "********", an empty one "".

secrets.description: Only with a passphrase: the nine secrets, encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key.

data.description: Base64 ciphertext followed by the 16-byte tag; associated data "sqmeter-backup/1".
